description: This file defines a custom TextureView class named AutoFitTextureView that allows setting an aspect ratio which it maintains during measurement. It provides methods to set the aspect ratio and overrides onMeasure to adjust the view's size accordingly.

classes.name: AutoFitTextureView
classes.description: A TextureView subclass that can be assigned an aspect ratio which it will preserve when measuring its dimensions.

methods.name: AutoFitTextureView(Context)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view with a context, delegating to the main constructor.

methods.name: AutoFitTextureView(Context, AttributeSet)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view with context and XML attributes, delegating to the main constructor.

methods.name: AutoFitTextureView(Context, AttributeSet, int)
methods.description: Main constructor calling the superclass constructor.

methods.name: setAspectRatio(int, int)
methods.description: Sets the desired aspect ratio for the view, and requests a layout pass.

methods.name: onMeasure(int, int)
methods.description: Overrides the measurement to enforce the aspect ratio when sizing the view.
